hook: the text you keep putting off
note: Whoever you just thought of, tell them. Life is too short for "I meant to."
ig: the message sitting in your drafts 📩
Send it before you talk yourself out of it.
tt: send this to them. then send the real message.
yt: Tell Them Before You Forget 📩
A tiny note about the message you keep postponing. Send it to someone today.

note: Thank you for the stories, the snacks, and the way you always said "one more" when Mom said no.

tt: tag the cousin who was secretly the favorite
yt: For Grandma 🧶 A Tiny Thank You Note
Grandparents deserve a thank you. Send this tiny note to yours.

note: Nothing to prove today. Sleep in, eat slowly, call someone you love. Saturdays are for being human.
ig: permission to do absolutely nothing today ☁️

tt: send to the friend who works on weekends
yt: A Gentle Saturday Reminder ☁️

tt: be nice to yourself this monday
send this to the one who apologizes too much

Be gentle with yourself today. A tiny note to start the week.

send this to your dad and screenshot his reply

note: You showed up all week, even on the hard days. That's not small. That's everything.

Send it to someone who had a long week.
tt: send this to the coworker who carried the team

A tiny note for anyone who showed up all week.

hook: sunday night, before the new week

Send this instead of "we should catch up sometime."
tt: we didn't drift, life got busy
send this to the friend you miss
yt: To The Friend I Haven't Talked To In A While 🌿
Life got busy, not the friendship. Send this to an old friend.

tt: send this to the friend building something

ig: Tag the one you'd talk to for hours.

send this to someone who needs it
